g.title: stm32_firmware_architecture
g.text: AERIS-10 - STM32F746 firmware layered architecture (hand-drawn from source)
Drawing ID: SD-03 Revision: A Date: 2026-10-09 Status: PARTIAL - HAL/CubeMX/USB-middleware layer is absent from the repository (dashed red)

Source: 9_Firmware/9_1_Microcontroller/9_1_3_C_Cpp_Code/main.cpp (2411 lines), main.h; 9_1_1_C_Cpp_Libraries/*.c|*.cpp|*.h (131 files: ADI no-OS, ST HAL glue, sensor drivers); docs/STM32/STM32_PROJECT_RECONSTRUCTION.md
CODE = 9_1_3_C_Cpp_Code, LIB = 9_1_1_C_Cpp_Libraries. Every edge is an #include or a call found in the sources (file:line in the label).

g.title: legend
g.text: blue = application code; green cluster = driver sources present in LIB/; purple = HAL layer (present vs MISSING);
orange = present but with a documented defect; red dashed = absent from repository; grey dotted = included but no call site found (UNVERIFIED)
solid edge = #include or direct call (file:line); dotted edge = HAL handle passed/used; dashed red edge = depends on a missing file
Handles: CODE/main.cpp:108-118 (hi2c1..3, hspi1, hspi4, htim1, huart5, huart3), :129 extern hUsbDeviceFS
HAL modules enabled: LIB/stm32f7xx_hal_conf.h:38-88 (HAL, SPI, TIM, UART, PCD, GPIO, EXTI, DMA, RCC, FLASH, PWR, I2C, CORTEX); no DMA handle is ever created
Known firmware defects C1-C7: docs/STM32/STM32_PROJECT_RECONSTRUCTION.md section STM-T04
NOT VERIFIED: compilation (no toolchain/HAL in repo), USB VID/PID, interrupt priorities, I2C bus speeds, whether adar1000.c is linked
